findings.title: Currentness can return after actual participant context has ended during final native close
findings.evidence: Private actual-context control arms after the final cached payload _check. During the final _git.close_native callback it invokes the real enclosing context.__exit__(None,None,None). require_current then returns without refusing, although the actual owner _active is False. No production/private flag is assigned by the reproducer.
findings.cause: close_native checks _live(ready=True) only before its observations and lacks a final lifetime/PID/spent closure after the final provider native observation. spend trusts that returned close and sets _spent afterward. before_replace similarly has no final lifetime check after its input callbacks.
findings.required_change: Close actual PID/context/spent eligibility after final native observations before returning currentness, consuming the participant, or allowing a publication. Preserve the actual acquiring context binding; do not reconstruct rights from the saved document.
